title: Parcel pickup

warning.title: Check carefully before confirming
warning.text: Once pickup is confirmed, you''re responsible for the parcel and committed to the transport. If something is wrong, refuse rather than accept.
warning.textShort: You become responsible for the parcel. If something is wrong, refuse rather than accept.

subtitle: Visually inspect the content, take your photos, then confirm.
sectionSubtitle: Compare the parcel with {shipperFirstName}''s declaration (on the right), then confirm.

declared.title: What {shipperFirstName} declared
declared.sub: Compare with what she physically hands you
declared.subShort: Compare with what she hands you
declared.compareHint: Stays visible during your inspection — compare every point of the parcel.

checklist.title: Inspect the content
checklist.sub: Check each point after physical inspection

items.WEIGHT_OK: The weight seems to match the declaration ({weight} kg)
items.NO_FORBIDDEN: No prohibited items present (weapons, drugs, counterfeits, etc.)
items.PACKAGING_OK: Packaging is correct and the parcel can travel safely
items.ITEMS_IDENTIFIED: I have seen and identified every item in the parcel
items.ITEMS_IDENTIFIED_short: I''ve seen and identified every item

photos.title: Your photos
photos.sub: Photograph what you take charge of — these photos are evidence in case of dispute
photos.subShort: Photos serve as evidence in case of dispute
photos.hint: Recommended: 1 photo of the unpacked content and 1 photo of the packed parcel ready for transport.

notes.title: Notes
notes.sub: Anything to document? A particularity, a reservation?
notes.placeholder: E.g.: Small tear on packaging reported to {shipperFirstName} before departure

final.info: By confirming, {shipperFirstName} will receive her 6-digit delivery code. You officially become responsible for the parcel until handover to {recipientFirstName}.
final.infoShort: By confirming, {shipperFirstName} will receive her delivery code.

validation.checklistIncomplete: Check all 5 verification points before confirming
validation.photoMissing: Add at least 1 photo before confirming

refuse.dialogIntro: The Deal will be cancelled and {shipperFirstName} fully refunded. Refusing a non-compliant parcel never harms your reputation.
refuse.toastSuccess: Parcel refused. {shipperFirstName} has been notified and will be refunded.
refuse.toastError: Error refusing the parcel. Try again.

confirm.toastSuccess: Pickup confirmed! {shipperFirstName} has received her delivery code.

accessCta.title: On the day: parcel pickup
accessCta.subtitle: When you meet {shipperFirstName}, inspect the parcel and confirm pickup — she''ll then receive her delivery code.
